name: When should I consider replacing my door latch instead of repairing it?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing my door latch instead of repairing it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consider replacing your door latch if it's severely damaged, outdated, or if repair costs approach the price of a new, more reliable unit. Frequent malfunctions after previous repairs, a desire for upgraded security features, or a change in aesthetic preferences are also good reasons to opt for replacement rather than repeated repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replace a latch if it's severely damaged, frequently malfunctions, is outdated, or if repair costs are high.
